summary: The implementation of `expand_cron_field` is incomplete as it fails to implement the required out-of-bounds validation (Req 2).
key_findings: Req 2 requires raising `ValueError('cron_out_of_bounds')` for values outside `[min_v, max_v]`, but the code silently accepts any integer.
The provided test suite does not include cases to verify the rejection of out-of-bounds values.
Existing legacy behavior is preserved, but the new feature lacks critical error handling.
missing_or_broken: Missing ValueError raise for out-of-bounds inputs
Missing test cases for out-of-bounds validation
